reviews.text: Peaceful and suitable for our cat.
Specialist cat veterinarians. Open late and on Saturdays.
Such great staff, and so kind to my cat
Our three cats could not be in better hands. These are people that genuinely care for animals.
Very nice staff
Wonderful caring staff

I have been with the cat hospital for 7 years now with my cat stitch and now my kitten LiLo also. Claire Meade is so professional, kind,  helpful and knowledgeable. My cats are in the best place to keep them healthy and well, Claire and all the girls who work here are the best that there is, the are kind, helpful and most of all invested in the overall health of the kitties. I would highly recommend the cat hospital the best place for your cat to be looked after and cared for. My cats are both healthy and happy 😁 thanks to Claire and the amazing Team at the Cat hospital 🏥.

Always a pleasure to deal with. They look after my cats very well. And are also lovely to me.. Clare is a gem.
Very accommodating also with regards time I can visit and paying my bill.
The only place for your kitty
Outstanding care ,very friendly staff
There are not enough positive words to describe how amazing the folks here are. Responsive , helpful and trust them with the most important things in our life.
Highly recommend professional services at the Cat hospital. Very helpful and friendly staff.
Very professional, and genuinely interested. Given plenty of time and not rushed, nor pushed /shamed into buying top rated products like previous vet I used.

Amazing staff, great experience so specialised for cats.
Received the best ever advice and care for our cat who unfortunately has been so unwell but is now on his way to a better quality of life.
Very professional and helpful.

As it says on the tin it is a Cat Hospital and as such will give excellent care to your Cat. We have had a number of RagDoll cats over the years and they have always been looked after very well in the Cat Hospital .
The consulting room is spacious, it has diffusers to help with the cats being less stressed, they can walk around the consulting room. Staff are wonderful.
Your cat is treated with top priority, as it should be.
Excellent
They are some of the greatest people to bring your Cat to, they bring all their love to every cat that comes in to them. I can't recommend them more they are the best.

Probably the most caring vets out there. The love these guys give every cat & the patience they have is beyond amazing. We put to sleep our 18 year old girl and the care they went to for us was so admirable, I don’t think they could have been kinder to us if they tried. Clare also got to the bottom of one of our cats illnesses that so many vets before couldn’t solve. We now have two kittens registered with the cat hospital, when the cats go into them the guys care for them so much & even sent pictures of updates of them. Honestly don’t hesitate to bring your cat here. The kindest bunch around & Sinead especially is one of the loveliest girls I’ve ever met. I could go on and on but again the best of the best. 💗 a proper community of people who love their jobs and want to help you.

I have five cats, all of whom attend The Cat Hospital in Cork. Registering them was very straightforward, and we can always get an appointment when needed. This outstanding team has significantly improved our cats' health.
Mrs. Carrot has lost over 4 kg thanks to their Curvy Cat Club program, Mr. Carrot gets his heart ultrasounds on time, and Revan has been successfully treated for eye and skin conditions.
The team excels not only at diagnosing and treating health issues but also at making our cats feel comfortable during their visits. Their communication is excellent, and they always strive to make the process of bringing in our pets as easy as possible.
Our cats attend their annual check-ups and vaccinations regularly, and we’re thrilled to have found such a caring and skilled team to look after them.
Thank you so much for everything.
The greatest veterinary practice in Cork. Clare is amazing, and so is everyone who works with her. I wouldn't trust my cat Cooper with anybody else.
I wouldn't trust anyone else with the health of my cats and foster kittens.

Great people , I have a lovely affectionate cat that be frisky when cornered and the handling was as tactful as can be

Thanks staff!
Very efficient and friendly people running this clinic.
The cat hospital is brilliant. The team are very knowledgeable and caring. I could not recommend this place highly enough!
Claire and the team here are always so helpful and provide exceptional and specialised care. We have been attending them for a number of years and wouldn't take our cats anywhere else.

I can not recommend enough the service that this clinic provides for cats. We had an emergency situation so I have sent them an e-mail explaining the situation and that we would like a second opinion as wasn’t satisfied with the treatment and care from the previous clinic. They immediately responded and they did all the tests quick enough including an ultrasound where we found out that our cat was late stage with gastro lymphoma.Even though they couldn’t do miracles for my cat in order to survive, they treated Yuki(our cat)with the utmost care and compassion. Kristin was the one that cared for her and always available at any question that we had about the treatment and the cat’s wellbeing. Kristin was also checking on her through e-mails and calls and I personally never met any vet so kind, compassionate and dedicated as Kristine. The clinic is fabulous (cats only)and every member of the staff knew the situation and actually we felt that they were there for us understanding our pain.
Yuki is gone now in a better place but thank you Kristine and to all staff members that knew Yuki.
Best regards
Di&Val
